Match the requested metric to its biological input object and observation unit.

  sequences are aligned.

representation.name: Batch parsimony-informative-site percentages
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
phykit --version >/dev/null
mkdir -p extracted
python - "$(inputs.alignment_zip.path)" <<'PY'
import pathlib
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile

archive = sys.argv[1]
outdir = pathlib.Path("extracted")
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zf:
    for info in zf.infolist():
        name = info.filename
        if name.endswith(".mafft") and not name.startswith("/") and ".." not in pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).parts:
            target = outdir / pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).name
            with zf.open(info) as src, target.open("wb") as dst:
                shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
PY
find extracted -type f -name '*.mafft' -print > members.unsorted
sort members.unsorted > members
test -s members
printf 'alignment\tinformative_sites\ttotal_sites\tpercentage_informative_sites\n' > metrics.tsv
count=0
while IFS= read -r alignment
do
    phykit parsimony_informative_sites -a "$alignment" > metric
    IFS=' ' read -r informative total percentage < metric
    test -n "$informative"
    test -n "$total"
    test -n "$percentage"
    name=${alignment#extracted/}
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$informative" "$total" "$percentage" >> metrics.tsv
    count=$((count + 1))
done < members
test "$count" -eq 255
